findings.title: Explicit null recipe bypasses the record-specific command guard
findings.actual: recipe:null becomes the truthy string None in the guard; apply writes it and native strict validation returns zero errors.
findings.rule: The seeder explicitly requires a record-specific executable recipe. add-record SKILL.md:23 requires runnable detection coverage; DetectionMethod recipe is a command template, not a null value.
findings.minimal_fix: Require an actual string before checking stripped content and a leading comment marker. Preserve existing validation and do not claim the tool was executed.
regressions: Explicit null and absent/blank/comment-only recipes refuse before any selected output.
A valid string recipe still creates and replays byte-identically.
findings.limit: This demonstrates the explicit local guard bypass, not a claim that every registry fallback is absent or that the submitted records have null recipes.

findings.title: Protein carrier accession can be minted as a trait-class identifier
findings.actual: UniProtKB:P12345 with term_kind CLASS is created and passes strict validation.
findings.rule: .claude/skills/add-record/SKILL.md:21 explicitly states UniProtKB carriers never belong in ProteinTraitRecord identifier; AGENTS.md:72-77 routes carriers through reviewed grounding.
findings.minimal_fix: Reject the explicitly prohibited UniProtKB primary-ID namespace before writing; do not ban legitimate class-level external CURIEs or pretend CLASS alone proves semantic identity.
regressions: UniProtKB primary identifier refuses the whole selected batch.
Legitimate internal trait identifiers and authoritative class identifiers remain accepted.
findings.limit: The current three submitted identifiers are internal trait-class IDs and are unaffected.

findings.title: Structural category and destination folder can disagree
findings.actual: STRUCT_CAVITY is written to data/traits/structure/secondary/ and passes strict validation.
findings.rule: Schema ProteinTraitCategoryEnum:3054-3057 ties fine-grained categories to data/traits/<axis>/<category>/; add-record SKILL.md:48-54 assigns axis, category and path together.
findings.minimal_fix: Require the bounded structural category to match its canonical destination folder, using the repository mapping/convention. Keep native axis/category validation as a separate gate.
regressions: STRUCT_CAVITY under secondary refuses the whole selected batch.
The actual secondary/cavity paths remain valid and exact-byte replay remains unchanged.
findings.limit: Native strict validation correctly rejects the tested SEQ_MOTIF/STRUCTURE mismatch; that working gate should not be duplicated or weakened.

findings.title: Symlinking the allowed report root redirects the output boundary
findings.actual: If research/structural-discovery-20261028 itself is a symlink, resolving the allowed root blesses the redirected directory; CLI apply creates both the trait and the report outside the intended lexical evidence subtree.
findings.rule: check_report_destination promises a new JSON under the owned evidence root and prevalidates protected paths before the writer. Existing nested-symlink coverage does not exercise redirection of the allowed root itself.
findings.minimal_fix: Anchor the allowed subtree to root.resolve() plus its lexical owned path and reject redirection of that subtree; compare the requested resolved path to that fixed boundary.
regressions: Symlink of the allowed root and escape through an ancestor refuse before seeding.
Nested ordinary directories inside the canonical root remain allowed.
findings.limit: The probe redirected into a sibling directory inside a disposable fixture; no real external path or existing evidence was overwritten.

findings.title: A predictably invalid report parent fails after corpus mutation
findings.actual: An existing regular file used as a report parent passes check_report_destination; apply creates the trait, then mkdir fails with FileExistsError and no requested report.
findings.rule: The report guard is documented to reject protected paths before invoking the writer. Predictable invalid-parent conditions can be rejected before mutation.
findings.minimal_fix: Validate/create permitted parent directories and verify report-parent usability before seed(), retaining exclusive final creation. Do not claim this prevents every runtime filesystem failure or makes the entire batch transactional.
regressions: A regular-file parent fails before any trait destination is created and preserves the pre-existing file.
Valid new report parents succeed; existing reports remain unmodified and exclusive creation is retained.
findings.limit: This is a bounded preflight/receipt robustness defect, not record corruption or an assertion of generic cross-process transactionality.
